description: Discard the locally stored Kia session (the remember-me token), so the next Kia call needs the one-time MFA bootstrap again. This is the recovery path when the stored token no longer works — Kia revoked it, the password changed, or the account moved to another device — and the only alternative is deleting the session file by hand. It makes NO network call: Kia is not told anything, only this machine forgets. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call makes NO network call and returns a preview plus a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). Nothing is deleted until it is confirmed.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

name: kia_forget_session
